title: Locale core: currency, locale and time zone from tenant and user settings in backend and desktop helpers
goal: Show money, dates and times in each agency's own currency and format, and each user's own time zone, through one set of helpers.
why: desktop/src/lib/utils.ts formatCurrency defaults to INR/en-IN (73 call sites); backend hardcodes ₹ in routes/invoices.ts, routes/payments.ts and services/exports/excel-export.ts; backend/src/utils/tz.ts defaults to Asia/Kolkata with no per-user zone; services/exchange-rate.ts falls back to INR-only constants and stores nothing.
steps: Backend utils/money.ts formatMoney(amount, currency, locale) via Intl.NumberFormat; replace the ₹ literals in invoices.ts, payments.ts, excel-export.ts (currency from the document row, locale from tenant settings).

Settings keys locale (default en-IN), date_format, country, phone_default_country added to the settings allow-list and validation; tenant 0046 users ADD locale TEXT, timezone TEXT; users/me PUT accepts them. tenant-summary returns { currency, locale, timezone, country, phoneDefaultCountry } with user overrides applied.
utils/tz.ts: tenantTz(settings, user?) prefers the user zone; existing "tenant-local today" helpers (B37) keep working.

Exchange rates: master 0019 exchange_rates (base, quote, rate REAL, as_of TEXT, source); services/exchange-rate.ts fetches daily (daily cron job set, R105 dispatch) and reads the latest stored rate, falling back to the last stored value instead of INR constants; never throws to the caller.

Desktop lib/locale.ts: a module store { currency, locale, timeZone } with setLocaleContext() called from the auth/session layer after login and after settings saves (lib/api/auth.ts or where tenant summary is stored), and useLocale() hook. formatCurrency(amount, currency?, locale?) defaults to the store (not INR/en-IN); compact lakh/crore only when locale is en-IN; formatDisplayDate in lib/dates.ts uses the store locale and timeZone.
tests: backend/test/locale-money.test.ts: GBP en-GB invoice email/export shows £; AED ar-AE formatting; user timezone overrides tenant; exchange rate fallback uses the stored last value.
desktop locale.test.ts and utils.test.ts: defaults come from the store; en-IN compact lakh only for en-IN; dates render in the user zone.
acceptance: No ₹ literal in backend/src outside tests and India-specific templates (grep).

cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit

cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3100 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8787/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/dashboard.spec.ts e2e/invoices.spec.ts e2e/payments.spec.ts e2e/reports.spec.ts
notes: Before editing read: this batch file, docs/readiness/READINESS-PLAN.md sections 0 and the design note for this area, desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3-4 (executor rules, worktree bootstrap with node_modules junctions; never npm install inside a worktree unless the batch adds a dependency, and then only in the main checkout by the orchestrator).

Backend tests follow the existing pattern (see backend/test/voip-callbacks.test.ts): import env, createExecutionContext, waitOnExecutionContext, applyD1Migrations from cloudflare:test; applyD1Migrations(env.MASTER_DB, env.TEST_MIGRATIONS) in beforeAll; POST /api/v1/test/reset; call worker.fetch(request, env, ctx). isolatedStorage is false and singleWorker true, so use unique ids/emails per test file.
The e2e demo tenant is Indian; formats there must not change (en-IN, INR, Asia/Kolkata).
Page-level literals are R203's; do not edit desktop/src/app/** here.
